description: This PHP source file defines the AuthenticationSubscriber class, which is an event subscriber handling authentication and session management for the OrangeHRM application. It manages request, controller, and exception events related to user authentication, including session expiration, user activity checks, and redirecting to login pages.

classes.name: AuthenticationSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to core kernel events to manage user authentication state, handle session expiration, and redirect or return appropriate responses based on user authentication status.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events to which the subscriber listens: request, controller, and exception events.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event, stops propagation if the user is not authenticated.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Handles the controller event, checks user authentication and session validity, throws session expired or unauthorized responses, or redirects unauthenticated users.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exceptions; redirects to login on session expiration, or propagates unauthorized responses.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Utility to retrieve the controller object from the event.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Fetches the system user entity based on current authenticated user ID.

methods.name: isLoggedInUserActive
methods.description: Checks if a system user is active and not deleted.

methods.name: resolveAuthenticatedUserException
methods.description: Determines if there are specific issues with the authenticated user, like disabled or terminated status.

methods.name: hasUserLastModifiedChanged
methods.description: Checks if the user’s last modified timestamp has changed compared to stored value.

methods.name: refreshUserLastModified
methods.description: Updates the stored last modified timestamp for the user.

methods.name: getUserLastModifiedValue
methods.description: Returns the last modified timestamp as a formatted string.

methods.name: logoutCurrentSession
methods.description: Invalidates user session and sets authentication state to false, also adds a flash message.
